data.one_liner: SVG ImageProvider for Flutter with caching support
data.what_it_does: Provides SVG ImageProvider and widget integrations for Flutter. It parses SVGs using jovial_svg or a WebView and caches files using flutter_cache_manager.
use_when: You need to load and cache network SVGs as a standard Flutter ImageProvider
You want to render SVGs using jovial_svg or WebView rendering
avoid_when: You need a simple vector asset loader without caching or external parsing libraries
strengths: Supports caching of SVG files via flutter_cache_manager
Provides options for parsing with jovial_svg or WebView
weaknesses: Relies on external heavy dependencies like flutter_inappwebview and jovial_svg

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: More widely adopted and standard library for rendering SVG assets and strings directly in Flutter.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Better suited for standard raster images with robust caching capabilities.
